key_insight: β-OPSD reframes on-policy self-distillation as a policy-optimization problem with a tunable KL weight β, then uses the closed-form solution as an efficient distillation target.
engineering_relevance: It offers a more stable and controllable way to train reasoning LMs, reducing the brittleness and engineering overhead of vanilla OPSD while preserving efficiency.
method: Generalize OPSD with a KL-regularized policy objective where β controls the trade-off between reference-policy anchoring and teacher guidance.
Derive the optimal policy as a geometric interpolation between the reference policy and the privileged teacher.
Approximate this solution cheaply by mixing token-level logits and using return-to-go credit assignment to align token updates with sequence-level objectives.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, where β-OPSD consistently improves optimization stability and downstream reasoning performance over vanilla OPSD.
watch_item: The method depends on well-chosen β and an efficient logit-mixing/distillation implementation; poor calibration could weaken the intended optimization-distillation match.
paper_title: $β$-OPSD: Deriving with Policy Optimization, Training with Self-Distillation
